Nora (PM): Quick design huddle on API key UX. Trying a 'soft disable' inline action vs full revoke in manage drawer. Mock: https://figma.com/s/soft-disable-keys
Eli (eng): Soft disable idea sounds safe. Can you clarify differences? does soft disable block new auths but keep existing sessions alive?
June (design): Exactly. Inline "Disable" toggles a flag that prevents new token exchanges; full "Revoke" (in drawer) rotates/invalidate existing tokens immediately.
Kai (a11y): Accessibility: both actions need clear labels + aria-describedby to explain the effect. Don't rely only on color or icon.
Nora (PM): Copy proposals: Inline button label = "Disable" with tooltip: "Stop new uses of this key; existing sessions keep working." In manage drawer the destructive CTA = "Revoke key (invalidate now)" with warning copy.
Eli (eng): Implementation note: we'll keep a 5-30 minute grace window for graceful migration when users click Rotate. For Disable, no overlap  we want to allow existing clients? we should be explicit.
June (design): UX idea: show a small inline status pill "Disabled (new auths blocked)" with a 1-line explanation and an action to "Re-enable". Keep Revoke gated behind an extra confirm with type-to-confirm.
Kai (a11y): Type-to-confirm is fine if we provide an accessible input label and error messaging. Also ensure focus is trapped in the confirmation dialog and returns to the row after close.
Nora (PM): Empty state wording draft: "No API keys yet. Create a dev key to try out integrations. Use read-only scopes for testing." CTA: "Create key". Include a tiny copyable snippet and put focus on the CTA when page loads.
Eli (eng): For create flow: after creation show the secret once with a clear instruction: "Download the secret now. We won't show it again." Buttons: primary "Download secret" secondary "Copy to clipboard".
June (design): Copy tweak: use "Save secret now" as microcopy in the modal header. Also add a subtle 'how to rotate' link in the success state.
Kai (a11y): Copy-to-clipboard must trigger a toast with role="status" announcing "Secret copied to clipboard". Also the masked secret toggle must have aria-pressed and live label updates.
Nora (PM): Edge case: if a user clicks Disable while there are active clients, we should warn: "Disabling will prevent new clients from connecting. Existing tokens will continue to work until revoked." Shorter alt: "Will block new auths; existing sessions continue." Keep confirm step lightweight.
Eli (eng): Telemetry: show "last used" and "active IPs" (masked) in the row expansion. Limit to last 8 entries and mask middle octets for privacy.
June (design): Visuals: use an amber surface for Disabled state (non-destructive), red for Revoke. Provide icons: shield-off for Disable, trash for Revoke. Also show a tiny timeline sparkline for usage.
Kai (a11y): Ensure color is not the only affordance. Add text and icons. For the sparkline provide an aria-label like "Usage over 24h: low/medium/high".
Nora (PM): Quick dev ask: can we add an inline 'undo' for Disable for 2 minutes? helps accidental clicks. Show small snackbar with "Disabled. Undo".
Eli (eng): Undo doable. We'll implement soft-disable + undo window where backend toggles a temporary flag until the undo window expires.
ops-bot: deploy:preview #keys-soft-disable deployed -> https://preview.redwood.ai/keys-soft-disable
June (design): One more microcopy: confirmation dialog for Revoke: header "Revoke key?" body "This will immediately stop any client using this key. Consider rotating instead to avoid downtime." confirm CTA: "Revoke permanently".
Kai (a11y): Final a11y checklist: focus management on expand/collapse, aria-live for row changes, accessible confirm dialogs, role="status" for toasts, masks not persisting in DOM. I'll run the keyboard walkthrough once preview is up.
Nora (PM): Thanks all. I'll update the figma with these changes and ping eng + a11y when mock is posted. :raised_hands:
